subject: MAP draft & next steps - Redwood MAP kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@northlake.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & next steps - Redwood MAP kickoff

Hi Samir -

Great to meet you and the NorthLake team on the discovery call today. Per our conversation, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) that lays out the key milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can align on a realistic timeline to pilot Redwood in your ingest/embedding pipeline.

High-level recap from the call:
- Primary use case: semantic search across customer support docs (ingest + embeddings + reranking).
- Target users: support ops and search team (approx. 10-20 users for PoC).
- Key success metrics: 95th pct latency < 300ms for query stream, embedding quality parity, and integration stability.
- Risk areas: SSO onboarding, VPC peering for private deployment, and procurement timing.

Attached: 20260308-NorthLake-MAP-draft.xlsx (initial MAP) and Redwood product sheet. The MAP includes suggested milestones; see summary below.

Suggested MAP (initial draft) - milestone summary:
1) Kickoff & stakeholder confirmation (owner: Samir / Marissa) - confirm stakeholders, access, and acceptance criteria.
2) Technical discovery & scoping (owner: Aditya) - deep dive on SSO, data residency, and network requirements.
3) Pilot environment setup (owner: Redwood infra + NorthLake IT) - VPC peering or hosted connection, test dataset ingest.
4) Integration & validation (owner: Aditya / NorthLake eng) - API integration, embedding verification, latency tests.
5) Pilot review & decision (owner: Samir / Priya) - success metrics review and next steps (expand or iterate).

Dependencies called out in the attached MAP:
- VPC peering or secure public endpoints (network team)
- SSO/SAML configuration (identity team)
- Procurement/PO and security questionnaire completion (procurement/security)

Two timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (accelerated): 6 weeks to pilot kickoff - assume procurement and security fast-tracked, and VPC peering completed in week 2. Target close (pilot sign-off) = 2026-04-23.
- Option B (standard): 10-12 weeks - allows for procurement windows and extra validation. Target close (pilot sign-off) = 2026-05-28.

Ask: please confirm the list of internal stakeholders we should include on the MAP (names + emails), which timeline option you prefer, and any additional acceptance criteria we should add. Once confirmed, I'll update the MAP and schedule a short kickoff with all stakeholders.

Thanks - looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: 20260308-NorthLake-MAP-draft.xlsx, redwood-product-sheet.pdf

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@northlake.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@northlake.com>, northlake-security@northlake.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 08:03:42 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps - Redwood MAP kickoff

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick thoughts from our side after syncing with the core stakeholders this morning: 

Stakeholders to include on the MAP: 
- Samir Gupta (I will be overall project sponsor) - samir.gupta@northlake.com
- Priya Menon (Procurement lead) - priya.menon@northlake.com
- Rahul Iyer (CTO / integration owner) - rahul.iyer@northlake.com
- Neha Sharma (Security) - northlake-security@northlake.com

We prefer Option B (standard) given upcoming procurement cycles, but are open to accelerating if procurement can prioritize. Target for pilot sign-off: end of May (2026-05-28) looks right.

A couple of asks/notes:
- Please add a technical milestone for SSO/SAML and a clear checklist for security questionnaire deliverables (Neha will be tracking).
- For the integration team, Rahul wants a brief from Aditya on API endpoints and expected throughput (QPS) so they can size infra - can Aditya share an initial estimate?
- Priya will send PO timing once we confirm costs.

If you can update the MAP with stakeholders and the standard timeline and share the Drive link, we'll confirm internally and get Priya copied on any procurement threads.

Regards,
Samir
Senior Director, Product Ops | NorthLake Systems
samir.gupta@northlake.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 08:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps - Redwood MAP kickoff

Marissa - quick internal note (copying in Rishi where helpful):

Thanks for the summary. A few technical items I recommend we add explicitly to the MAP under dependencies/milestones: 
- Network: VPC peering or Private Link + firewall rules (estimate setup: 1-2 weeks once NW team approves).
- Identity: SSO/SAML metadata exchange (1 week).
- Data residency: confirm if any data must remain in-region; affects deployment choice.
- Integration validation: define throughput target (Samir mentioned expected QPS ~50-100 for PoC?) - if true, we should size the pilot for 2x headroom.

Estimated durations for technical milestones:
- Technical discovery & scoping: 3 business days (deep dive session + write-up).
- Environment setup (peering + IAM): 1.5-2 weeks (dependent on NW ticketing).
- Integration & validation: 2-3 weeks (includes embed generation and latency tests).

I can produce a 1-page tech brief with endpoints, payload sizes, and throughput guidance to share with Rahul - will send by EOD if that works. Also recommend we add a milestone for "security questionnaire completion" with Neha as owner so Priya can gate procurement.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks Samir - and thanks Aditya for the technical breakdown. I updated the MAP (attached) and added the security milestone and SSO checklist as requested. Summary of the updated MAP (high level):

Milestones & owners:
- Stakeholder confirmation & kickoff meeting - Samir (NorthLake) / Marissa (Redwood) - week 0
- Technical discovery & scoping (deep dive) - Aditya - week 1
- Security questionnaire completion - Neha (NorthLake) / Rishi (Redwood) - week 1-2
- Environment setup (VPC peering / connectivity) - NorthLake NW team / Redwood infra - week 2-3
- Integration & validation (API + embeddings + latency tests) - Aditya / NorthLake eng - week 3-6
- Pilot review & sign-off - Samir / Priya - end of pilot window

Timeline options (updated):
- Option A (accelerated): Pilot sign-off target = 2026-04-23 - requires procurement/PO and security to prioritize.
- Option B (standard): Pilot sign-off target = 2026-05-28 - recommended based on your procurement window.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm the stakeholder list (I have Samir / Priya / Rahul / Neha).
2) Confirm you prefer Option B (standard) as target (I'll lock dates in the MAP).
3) Confirm whether we should include a proof-of-concept SLA item for latency/availability during the pilot.

I've uploaded the MAP to Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleMAPFolder and linked the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2026-0192.

If that all looks good I'll schedule the 30-minute kickoff for next week and Aditya will send the 1-page tech brief for Rahul.

Thanks - Marissa
